A Perfect Evening of Flavors, Service, and Arabic Music at Walima – Sheraton Tunis
Apr 2026 • Business
Had a wonderful experience at Walima Restaurant at Sheraton Tunis. The service was absolutely magnificent , attentive, warm, and very professional. The variety of dishes offered a great selection, and the quality of the food was outstanding. Every plate was flavorful and beautifully prepared. The evening was made even more enjoyable with the lovely Arabic music in the background, creating a perfect and authentic atmosphere. Highly recommended!
